---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Flexi AMS
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement

---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## ✨ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. How should this feature work?

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Use Case
Describe how this feature would be used in real-world scenarios.

## 🎯 Benefits
What benefits would this feature bring to users?

## 📸 Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other applications.

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
Any technical considerations or constraints you're aware of?

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or information about the feature request.

## 🌟 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just a suggestion
